plan.record_aggregation: any channel anomaly; normal only if all selected channels evaluated normal; otherwise unknown
plan.wt_reference_training: N1 same speed/channel, windows at 0/10/20s; held-out N2 remains in denominator
plan.wt_threshold_rule: max training metric + max(3*1.4826*MAD, abs(median)*0.25, 1e-9), critical=warning+same margin
plan.bearing_assumption: ER16K n9/d7.94/D38.52/alpha0 conditional only; HUST pitch diameter unverified; Ottawa angle unverified. Scalar estimates are inferred, not independent speed ground truth.
plan.noise: No injected noise in main evaluation; actual acquisition noise level unknown.
